race.comment: KICK ON CHARLIE (11) made the right start at Grafton, finishing third on debut and beaten just under a length after covering ground early. With natural improvement second-up he sets the standard. ZOUBUCA SHOTS (10) has the stronger body of work, placing three times from five starts and respected in betting at Ipswich last week when fifth behind Star Of Paris. The quick back-up is the query, but she has been holding her form well enough to take this out. NOTES OF AUTUMN (12) debut ninth at Doomben. Had a start-bump and some late effort. Better for the experience and look for an improved run. I TRIED SO HARD (9) comes out of Doomben mid-week company into an easier country assignment and should strip fitter second-up. In the mix.
